# Vendored files

Third-party files the page serves itself, so a visitor's browser contacts no other site.
Generated by `scripts/build-board-vendor.mjs` in the private runner repository; do not edit by hand.

| Library | Version | Licence | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| OpenCharts | 2.2.0 | MIT | https://github.com/Hamza928505/OpenCharts, bundled by scripts/build-board-vendor.mjs; Chart.js 4.4.1 (MIT) is loaded on demand from opencharts/lib |
| SweetAlert2 | 11.26.25 | MIT | https://sweetalert2.github.io/ |
| SheetJS Community Edition | 0.18.5 | Apache-2.0 | https://sheetjs.com/, builds the .xlsx files in the browser |
| Font Awesome Free (solid) | 6.7.2 | Icons CC BY 4.0, font SIL OFL 1.1, code MIT | https://fontawesome.com/license/free |

Each folder carries its own licence text.
